== Notes ==

* While under the effect of this glyph, heroes will not use non-elemental spells.
{{anomaly| This skill actually behaves identically to [[Glyph of Energy]], in that your elemental attributes are boosted ''for all'' purposes while under the effects of this glyph.
* Non-spell skills ([[Lightning Touch]], [[Shock]], [[Glyph of Immolation]] and [[Glyph of Swiftness]]) will take advantage of the bonus and ''will not'' count as a use of the glyph. 
* Any elemental attribute raised to at least 9 will trigger the bonus armor from [[Prismatic Insignia]]. }}
